about: The photographs the Building's surfaces are made from (crates/game/assets/textures/, by build.py). Every one is CC0. The Commons files are checked by the SHA-1 Commons publishes; the Panelka files by the SHA-1 of each file in the pack's zip. The rooms' details (rooms R5) are ambientCG materials (CC0), each checked by the zip's SHA-1 and its maps' own.

moscow_rustication.title: File:DSC 03930 moscow july 2016 people.jpg
moscow_rustication.author: Rakoon
moscow_rustication.what: Tverskaya Street 11, Moscow: the rock-faced granite rustication of the Ministry of Education and Science building, built in 1949

arsenalna_floor.title: File:Арсенальная 05.jpg
arsenalna_floor.author: Antares 610
arsenalna_floor.what: Arsenalna station, Kyiv metro (opened 1960): the dark speckled granite floor slabs in front of the marble wall

ussr_ceiling.title: File:Dropped ceiling (USSR, 1980s) (01).jpg
ussr_ceiling.author: Georg Pik
ussr_ceiling.what: a dropped ceiling of the 1980s, USSR: mineral-fibre tiles with dark fissures; the faces of three tiles, quilted, for the rooms' acoustic tiles (rooms R5)

panelka.pack: PanelkaPack by Kureca, https://kureca.itch.io/panelka-pack ("No attribution required - CC0"; photographs of post-Soviet panel housing, its fences and yards; no generative AI, by the page)
panelka.author: Kureca

ambientcg.about: ambientCG (https://ambientcg.com), materials by Lennart Demes and contributors, all CC0 1.0 ("Public Domain"): https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/. Each is fetched as its 2K JPEG zip from https://ambientcg.com/get?file=<asset>_2K-JPG.zip.
ambientcg.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)

Smear004.what: a wiped smear on glass (photo-based; its Roughness map), for the windows' glass

SurfaceImperfections003.what: dirt run down a surface in streaks (its Opacity map), for the windows' glass

SurfaceImperfections015.what: a mottled film of dust (its Opacity map), for the windows' glass

polyhaven.about: Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com), textures all CC0 1.0 (https://polyhaven.com/license). Each map is fetched from https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/Textures/jpg/2k/<asset>/<file> and checked by its SHA-1.

plastered_wall_04.what: a plastered interior wall, 3.2 m a repeat

concrete_floor_worn_001.what: a worn indoor concrete floor, 3 m a repeat

rough_concrete.what: rough concrete, 1.23 m a repeat (a concrete wall with its own form-tie grid was tried: it fought the painted seams)

polyhaven_hdris.about: Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com) panoramas, all CC0 1.0 (https://polyhaven.com/license: "You can redistribute them", in a product you sell, no credit needed). Each is fetched as the 8K JPEG Poly Haven tonemapped from its HDRI, from https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/extra/Tonemapped%20JPG/<asset>.jpg, and checked by its SHA-1.

misty_farm_road.what: two gravel farm tracks between ploughed fields running away into fog, trees standing in it; a foggy afternoon, 2022-11-12 (the windows' view, docs/WINDOWS.md)
